howto: Pick a word length (Short, Medium or Long) and a category.
Guess the hidden word one letter at a time: tap the keyboard or type.
Each wrong letter adds a line to the drawing. Seven wrong and the round is lost. Five words make a game.
tips: Start with vowels: A, E, I, O and U are in almost every word.
After the vowels, try common letters like S, T, R and N.
Solve a word with no mistakes to earn a rose token that reveals a letter for free.
Words get longer as the five rounds go on.
Your win streak adds a bonus to every solved word.

controls.keyboard: Type a letter to guess it. Esc pauses.

difficulty: Three level bands by word length: Short (3-5 letters, ages 6-7), Medium (5-7, ages 8-9) and Long (7+, ages 10 and up). Within a game the words grow longer each round.

features.age-or-level-bands: Short, Medium and Long word levels on the title, each with an age guide
features.hints: In-game Hint reveals a letter; the arcade Hint suggests vowels first, then the letter that appears most in the word
features.grown-up-progress-report: Grown-ups button on the title: words tried and accuracy per level, practice days, the words missed most and a suggested next level
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first game walk through a guess, the drawing, hints and a solve; replay with Learn to play
features.results: Game Over card with score, best, best streak and perfect run
